decision: Generated field tables render field type names as Grounded links. Field types should be modeled as canonical data_type or lifecycle_type units when the project wants every displayed type to have a link target, and the renderer should resolve recognized collection wrappers such as list[...] and [] before linking so specialized types like slice_ref[] still point at the canonical type page.
name: Link resolvable field types
description: Documents the Link resolvable field types decision and explains how it guides Grounded behavior or project maintenance.
